title: chore(console): move the objectui pin to b41ed7f68956 so Console Pin Gate builds again
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DFPJsyK4BzCzQ782unkED33)_

Fixes #25713

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What this does

Moves `.objectui-sha` from `2958f17e9c6a` to objectui `main` **`b41ed7f68956c8cfda21bc790548361af81b09ac`**, the merge of objectstack-ai/objectui#13485 (the change behind objectstack-ai/objectui#13478: the translation preview draws the `positions` and `permissions` groups). This is the pin target the devx seat chose on the card (comment 6392376241), not objectui `main` HEAD.

- Compare: https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/compare/2958f17e9c6a...b41ed7f68956 (15 commits, all on objectui `main`; `git merge-base --is-ancestor` exits 0).
- `.objectui-sha` and `.changeset/console-b41ed7f68956.md` were written by `scripts/bump-objectui.sh b41ed7f68956c8cfda21bc790548361af81b09ac --no-commit`. Neither was hand-edited. The digest walked the range completely: 9 releasing changesets, 1 release-nothing, 6 commits with no changeset; objectui declared `minor`, recorded as `patch`.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json` was re-recorded by `node scripts/gen-sdui-manifest-node.mjs` over the tree `scripts/build-console.sh` built at the new pin. `sdui.manifest.json` itself is **byte-identical** (sha256 `d1fde278ffd6…`, 107 components), so objectui's public component registry did not change over the range.
- `packages/sdui-parser/objectui-lockstep.json` was re-recorded by `pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep` (see "In-place addition" below).

## Why

At the old pin, objectui's `@object-ui/app-shell` fails `tsc` against this tree's spec, which declares the `positions` / `permissions` translation groups. So `Console Pin Gate` is red on `main` (schedule `CI` run 40136758584), and the release gate refuses a cut while it stays red. Version Packages #25640 is open.

## Reproduction (local, the Console Pin Gate job's own steps)

`Console Pin Gate` runs only on `push` and `schedule` (its `if:` in `ci.yml` excludes `pull_request` and `merge_group`), so this PR's checks cannot show it. Instead, every step of the job was run locally on this branch: `pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/client...`, then `bash scripts/build-console.sh`, then the dist presence assertion, `pnpm check:console-sha` and `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp`. Heap was `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=6144`, because a 4-CPU / 15 GB cloud container OOMs `app-shell`'s `tsc` at Node's default heap.

| Pin | Tree | Result |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `2958f17e9c6a` (old) | objectstack `f3fea0a03d` | **RED**, `build-console.sh` exit 2: `@object-ui/app-shell:build: src/views/metadata-admin/previews/TranslationPreview.tsx(99,3): error TS1360: Type '{ objects: …; … 7 more …; settingsCommon: … }' does not satisfy the expected type` (a `Record` keyed by the spec's translation groups, `positions` and `permissions` among them). Same failure as run 40136758584. |
| `b41ed7f68956` (new) | this branch, head `8b7fcf45` | **GREEN**, `build-console.sh` exit 0 (34/34 objectui tasks): bundle canary present; single-zod canary finds one literal `{major:4,minor:6,patch:7}` over 2291 assets; spec injection carries this tree's spec only (1 of 1 injected-only description present, all 3 pin-only absent, reference is objectui's own build of objectstack `47af3dde42bb`); `dist ready (66308 KB) from objectui@b41ed7f68956`. Then `pnpm check:console-sha` exit 0 and `pnpm check:console-injection --require-stamp` exit 0. |

The build at the new pin ran before the manifest re-record, so it printed the expected warning that the record still named `2958f17e9c6a`. After the re-record, `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` exits 0 at pin `b41ed7f68956`.

Acceptance after merge: the next schedule `CI` on `main` reads `Console Pin Gate` `success`. That run id will be reported on #25713.

## Contract changes the range brings

None on what a metadata author writes. Every objectui changeset in the range declares `Metadata-protocol: none`. In detail:

- **SDUI component registry:** unchanged. The manifest is byte-identical, as above.
- **sdui-parser lockstep:** unchanged. objectui's `packages/sdui-parser/src` did not change over the range. The grammar region blob `0131f27cf86d`, the 25 diagnostic codes and the `not-a-container` predicate blob `76c18fb95d1f` all agree.
- **objectui's own `.objectstack-sha`:** `915e94049922` → `47af3dde42bb`, by way of `e649c2d91e` (objectstack 18.1.0, objectui `0984c77e1`). `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` accepted this tree standing in for it, with no dependency-name refusal.
- **objectui release `a3c0da922`** (`chore: release packages (#13289)`): the `@object-ui` workspace version recorded in the manifest record moves from `18.0.0` to `18.1.0`.
- **Readiness work for the ui-merge (objectstack#25685 / `cd70b7818`, objectstack#25723 / `c85408f`):** react and `@types/react` are pinned to 19.3.0, and `zod` is declared `^4.6.5`, the range this monorepo declares. Workspace-root readers resolve one level up when the tree sits under `ui/`. Tooling only, no published behaviour changes. The console bundle still carries a single zod.
- **objectui#13478 / `b41ed7f68`** (`Clause-②: yes` in objectui): `isSpecTranslationData` now also recognises a served translation document by the `positions` / `permissions` groups. That is the consumer catching up with the spec this repo already declares; this repo's contract does not change.
- **Console behaviour:** form actions open inside their app, create forms no longer lock fields through `readonlyWhen`, `html` / `richtext` values are sanitized with `rehype-sanitize`, settings evaluate `visible` through the expression interpreter and fail closed, and the chat UI leaves the first page load. All of it is listed in the changeset.

## In-place addition (outside the claimed file surface)

`pnpm check:sdui-lockstep` reds on any pin move (`[pin-moved]`: its record was taken at `2958f17e9c6a`), so the required lint job would be red without a re-record. Recorded with `OBJECTUI_ROOT=.cache/objectui-b41ed7f68956 pnpm gen:sdui-lockstep`, a clean detached checkout at the pin. Only `objectui.rev`, `objectui.revDate` and `recordedAgainstPin` move. The gate is then green: "this copy is byte-identical to objectui@b41ed7f68956 … agrees on all 25 diagnostic code(s) and on the `not-a-container` predicate". The four bounded-fix conditions hold: it is the same class as the manifest re-record (a pin-derived record); it is mechanical and generator-written; no in-flight claim holds `packages/sdui-parser/**` (#25711 and #25712 surfaces read); and the gate family was already in this diff's derived set. The file is not in `@objectstack/sdui-parser`'s `files[]`, so nothing it publishes changes and no extra changeset is needed.

## Serial note

#25711 (ui-merge 4a) lists `.objectui-sha` in its claimed surface, because it deletes the pin files at cutover. This PR modifies that file. Whichever of the two lands second resolves a delete/modify conflict on it. No other ui-merge child surface is touched. `origin/main` was merged before each push (no new commits since `f3fea0a03d`).

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at head `a2ad39d3`: 75 families derived. 73 exit 0. 2 are NOT MEASURED locally, both exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` needs a full `pnpm build`, and `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` needs an unshallow clone. CI runs both. `--ran` reconciliation: "75 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 73 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED".
- Among the 73: `check-sdui-manifest`, `check:sdui-lockstep`, `check:console-sha`, `check:console-injection`, `check:objectui-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:merge-driver`.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of 4 paths hit the register, so this PR is NOT governed. Size is +38 / -8.
- `node scripts/check-commit-card-trailers.mjs --range origin/main..HEAD`: 3 commits clean.
- No package source changed, so there is no package test or typecheck to run. CI's required set judges the rest.

## Acceptance notes

- The bump digest renders a changeset's declaration lines as its entry summary when the body opens with them. In this PR's changeset that shows as `**patch** — Clause-②: yes Metadata-protocol: none (objectui b41ed7f68)` and two `Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none` lines for `cd70b7818`. The same shape has already shipped in `packages/console/CHANGELOG.md` (for example, lines 256, 514 and 543). objectui's changesets now open with `Clause-②:` / `Metadata-protocol:` lines, so the first paragraph `parseChangeset` takes as `summary` is the declaration block, not the description. The changeset here is left exactly as generated. `scripts/objectui-changeset-digest.mjs` is in #25711's claimed surface. Reported to the seat for filing; dedupe words: objectui-changeset-digest summary declaration lines Clause-② first paragraph.
